en.name: Forest (Rush Duel)
en.effect: While this card is face-up in the Field Zone, face-up Insect, Beast, Plant, and Beast-Warrior Type monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF.

fr.name: Forêt
fr.effect: Tant que cette carte est face recto sur la Zone Terrain, les monstres de Type Insecte, Bête, Plante et Bête-Guerrier face recto sur le Terrain gagnent 200 ATK/DEF.

de.name: Wald
de.effect: Solange diese Karte offen in der Spielfeldzone liegt, erhalten offene Monster des Typs Insekt, Ungeheuer, Pflanze und Ungeheuer-Krieger auf dem Spielfeld 200 ATK/DEF dazu.

it.name: Foresta
it.effect: Mentre questa carta è scoperta nella Zona Terreno, i mostri scoperti di Tipo Insetto, Bestia, Pianta e Guerriero-Bestia sul Terreno guadagnano 200 ATK/DEF.

es.name: Bosque
es.effect: Mientras esta carta está boca arriba en la Zona del Campo, los monstruos de Tipo Insecto, Bestia, Planta y Guerrero-Bestia que estén boca arriba en el Campo ganan 200 ATK/DEF.

ko.name: 숲
ko.effect: 이 카드가 필드 존에 앞면 표시인 한, 서로의 필드의 앞면 표시 몬스터(곤충족 / 야수족 / 식물족 / 야수전사족)의 공격력 / 수비력은 200 올린다.
